title: TopiCLEAR: Adaptive embedding clustering for interpretable topic discovery from short texts
abstract: arXiv:2512.06694v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Topic discovery is a fundamental technique for text mining that identifies abstract topics within large document collections. A recent approach to topic discovery is to cluster document or sentence embeddings, typically obtained from pre-trained language models, and represent each cluster as a topic. Despite their strong empirical performance, the design principles linking the geometry of embedding spaces to human-interpretable topic organization remain unclear. Clarifying the relationship between these geometric structures and topic interpretability is therefore a key challenge in topic discovery. In this study, we propose TopiCLEAR (Topic discovery by CLustering Embeddings with Adaptive dimensionality Reduction), a simple framework that integrates document embeddings with iterative clustering based on adaptive dimensionality reduction. TopiCLEAR is guided by the hypothesis that human-interpretable topics correspond to low-dimension

translated_title: TopiCLEAR：基于自适应嵌入聚类的短文本可解释主题发现
translated_abstract: 主题发现是文本挖掘中的一项基础技术，用于识别大型文档集合中的抽象主题。近期的一种主题发现方法是对文档或句子嵌入（通常从预训练语言模型中获得）进行聚类，并将每个聚类表示为一个主题。尽管这些方法在实证上表现出色，但连接嵌入空间几何结构与人类可解释主题组织之间的设计原则仍不明确。因此，阐明这些几何结构与主题可解释性之间的关系是主题发现中的关键挑战。在本研究中，我们提出了TopiCLEAR（基于自适应降维的嵌入聚类主题发现），这是一个简单框架，集成了文档嵌入与基于自适应降维的迭代聚类。TopiCLEAR基于一个假设：人类可解释的主题对应于低维结构。
tldr: 本文提出TopiCLEAR框架，通过自适应降维的迭代嵌入聚类，验证了人类可解释主题对应低维结构的假设，从而提升短文本主题发现的解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TopiCLEAR, a framework that uses adaptive dimensionality reduction with iterative embedding clustering to validate the hypothesis that human-interpretable topics correspond to low-dimensional structures, enhancing interpretability in short-text topic discovery.
